answer: Aligned votes must rent distance at once: before n agents may act as a bloc, atlas counts only a set whose every pair crossed a different canyon in the same epoch, and each crossing locks saffron, burned if any two endpoints later sign alike. One lone agent pays nothing. The second needs one simultaneous canyon crossing; the kth adds k−1 more while earlier pairs stay apart. Faking n heads therefore means n(n−1)/2 concurrent crossings and saffron locks in one atlas epoch—bribed bodies, not clones.
